prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. "Loetgassen" (Solder Lanes), a crooked quarter of workshop lanes in the underground slums, seen from above. A large open plaza of worn dark cobblestones and oil-stained concrete fills the middle and lower part of the image - this is the large walkable area, wet, with puddles mirroring pink and cyan neon and a few orange sparks.
CENTER TOP: a narrow two-storey house that juts out from the top building row into the plaza - an analog repair workshop, the most eye-catching spot: a wooden front door completely plastered with colourful stickers, next to it a warm yellow-lit shop window stacked full of vinyl records and VHS cassettes, a small neon cassette symbol above (a symbol, no letters). Right of this house a narrow dark side passage leads behind it, where a round iron manhole cover lies on the ground.
TOP RIGHT: a row of two shopfronts on the upper building row: a cyberware shop with a half-open rolling shutter and cyan glow, mechanical arms and circuit boards in the window (a soldering-iron symbol, no letters); directly right of it a corrugated-metal courier hut with a big closed rolling shutter covered in scratched stickers and a cargo bike parked in front. Above these two shops, at the very top right of the image, a flat walkable tar-paper rooftop: a ramshackle pigeon loft built from old antennas and satellite dishes with little perches, and right next to it a thin steel radio mast with a ladder and a small maintenance platform, colourful fabric wristbands tied to its struts. A rusty iron staircase at the right edge climbs from the street up to that rooftop.
LEFT SIDE: a small backyard tai-chi studio inside the plaza: a square of green floor mats framed by potted plants, a paper lantern and a little bronze gong, separated from the street by a low brick wall with an opening.
TOP LEFT: workshop facades with open rolling shutters showing workbenches and a welding spot with flying sparks.
BOTTOM EDGE: low workbenches and junk stalls; at bottom left a messy tinkerer's stall with dangerous-looking home-made implants and a soldering station; at bottom center a grey metal signal-relay cabinet with blinking lights; at bottom right a square sewer grate set into the ground.
Around the plaza edges: big wooden cable drums, coiled cables, gas bottles, crates, oil barrels, a floor vent with steam; cables and a few laundry lines strung between the houses (drawn thin so they don't hide the floor).
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: TOP edge (north), left of center - a narrow lane leading up between the houses toward a pink-lit neon street; RIGHT edge (east), middle - a passage through a laundry courtyard, many washing lines full of hanging work overalls, toward pipe dwellings.
Time: night, after rain.
